name: Doric Greek
notes: Classification-only clade node for the Doric (West Greek) dialect group of Ancient Greek, spoken c. 800-100 BC across the Peloponnese, central/northern Greece, Crete, Rhodes and colonies. Sister branch to Attic-Ionic, not descended from it. Tsakonian is its only living descendant. Carries no phonology: never a data-inheritance source, only a step in the ancestry chain.
